subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): prevent distinct titles from silently overwriting each other

question: After the filename-budget defect is fixed, should memory-wiki adopt stable title-hash suffixes as the durable identity for future genuine title collisions?
rationale: The implementation changes persisted IDs and filenames only in collision cases and does not recover historical overwrites, so acceptance of that upgrade boundary belongs to the memory-wiki owner.

options.title: Adopt Scoped Hashes
options.body: Fix the filename cap, refresh onto current main, and land title-hash suffixes only when another title owns the readable base slug.

options.title: Require Recovery Plan
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers also define support or doctor handling for previously overwritten vault pages.

options.title: Choose Another Identity
options.body: Pause if title-derived hashes are not the desired permanent collision identity for synthesis and ingest pages.

recommendation.title: Adopt Scoped Hashes
recommendation.body: Fix the filename cap, refresh onto current main, and land title-hash suffixes only when another title owns the readable base slug.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the adjacent identity and retry changes and are the strongest available owner signal for the durable memory-wiki identity choice.
